basic_details.scholarship_name: Ghent University Top-Up Grants & BOF Doctoral Scholarships
basic_details.offering_entity: Ghent University (Universiteit Gent) & Special Research Fund (BOF, Belgium)
basic_details.major_restrictions: All faculties and English-taught Master's and PhD programs (Engineering and Architecture, Sciences, Bioscience Engineering, Medicine and Health Sciences, Economics, Veterinary Medicine, Law).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 Top-Up Grants and ~50 BOF doctoral scholarships annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Competitive merit pool targeting developing countries from the ODA list (typically 4 to 10 Pakistani scholars annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master's; 4 years (full PhD duration under sandwich or full-time BOF model)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of developing countries on the DAC list of ODA recipients (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with first-class honors or top 10% class standing for Master's; Master's/MPhil degree with high research potential for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum equivalent to distinction in Belgian grading (at least 14/20 or CGPA 3.30+ on 4.0 scale).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background in sciences, engineering, bioscience, or social sciences directly matching host faculty.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or completing final semester of qualifying degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research experience and publications heavily prioritized for PhD BOF applicants.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90; Medium of Instruction certificate accepted if official language of undergraduate instruction was English.

eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already obtained a degree at the same level at a Flemish university.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition fee reduced to standard Flemish subsidized fee rate (~€1,100/yr) and paid/reimbursed by scholarship grant.

admission_application_fee.details: Ghent University application processing fee refunded upon enrollment.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student housing available at UGent dormitories; rent (~€380–500/mo) paid from monthly grant.

monthly_stipend.details: Master's Top-Up Grant: €1,000/month living allowance (~PKR 305,000/mo). BOF PhD candidates: full employment fellowship of ~€2,400 to €2,600/month (~PKR 730,000 to 790,000/mo).

airfare.details: One-time flight allowance for travel between home country and Belgium.

visa_fee.details: Belgian Type D visa administrative fee (€220) and embassy application fee paid by candidate.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health, third-party liability, and repatriation insurance provided by Ghent University.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized student restaurants (Resto UGent: hot meals for students at ~€4.50 to €6.00).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Academic research infrastructure, high-performance computing, and library systems provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Bench fee / research operating budget (€310/month for PhD BOF researchers) allocated to the host research lab.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Settlement allowance provided upon arrival in Ghent.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Ghent University (Universiteit Gent, Belgium).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #169 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 100 in Academic Ranking of World Universities (Shanghai ARWU #84).
available_majors: Computer Science Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Bioscience Engineering: Cellular & Genetic Biotech, Environmental Sanitation, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Bioinformatics, Aquaculture, Statistical Data Analysis, Nuclear Fusion & Engineering Physics
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 24 months for Master's; 48 months for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with high distinction in corresponding field of study.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: PhD BOF candidates strictly require a Ghent University tenured professor (ZAP member) who acts as promoter and co-submits the proposal.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: For PhD BOF scholarships, contacting potential UGent professors 4-6 months before the February/March call with a tailored research concept note is essential.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Register on Oasis.ugent.be for academic admission. Step 2: For PhD, prepare joint research proposal with UGent promoter.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Identify study program or UGent research promoter (October-November).
2. Apply for academic admission via Oasis.ugent.be.
3. For Master's: Faculty reviews admitted candidates and nominates top students for Top-Up Grant.
4. For PhD: Co-author joint BOF proposal with promoter and submit to Research Council before early February.
5. Evaluation by Research Council in March/April.
7. Apply for Belgian Type D visa with official award letter.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Academic admission via Oasis followed by faculty nomination or BOF Research Council submission.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees or included in doctoral proposal dossier.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of academic purpose and development relevance to home country.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Mandatory for PhD: 10-page research proposal detailing state-of-the-art, work packages, Gantt chart, and societal impact.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV including publications, thesis title, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online interview conducted by prospective supervisor and doctoral advisory committee.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: Standard application processing fee (€100) on Oasis portal.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Legalized degrees and transcripts (HEC and MOFA attestation required for Pakistani applicants).
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English, Dutch, or French translations.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport
Complete academic transcripts and certificates with grading scales
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan and MOFA

required_documents_checklist.specification: Formal written agreement from UGent tenured professor to act as supervisor
IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+) or MOI certificate
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official IELTS or university MOI certificate

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual cycle for autumn semester intake.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Academic transcripts, class rankings, and prior honours)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Ghent University Research Council (BOF) and Faculty Internationalization Commissions.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty academic assessment -> Research Council scientific review -> Board of Governors ratification.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with proven research potential, journal papers or conference presentations, and strong endorsement from Belgian promoters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani researchers in agricultural sciences, biotechnology, water engineering, and computer science.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Vietnam, Indonesia, Ethiopia, Iran, India, Nigeria, Colombia, Pakistan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Oasis registration fee is €100 paid only on official UGent portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Ghent University conducts no recruitment through commercial agencies.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Belgian Embassy visa application and VFS handling fees (~PKR 35,000)
Medical certificate from embassy-approved panel physician (~PKR 25,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need to speak Dutch. (Truth: All Master's and PhD programs under these schemes are 100% in English).
MYTH: You can apply for BOF PhD without a Belgian supervisor. (Truth: You must have a formal written agreement with a UGent professor who co-applies with you).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Fake websites claim Top-Up grants cover whole families; the stipend is strictly intended for the single grantee.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain solid course progression and pass annual doctoral advisory committee (DAC) evaluations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time research dedication at UGent laboratories.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress report submitted to BOF Research Council.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Full employment benefits under Belgian social security for PhD researchers; student visa work rights up to 20 hours/wk for Master's.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; Belgium offers a 12-month post-study search year (zoekjaar) permit for international graduates.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Grant is revoked if research output milestones or laboratory attendance are abandoned.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing thesis topic requires approval from both supervisor and Research Council.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: PhD scholarships are awarded for 2+2 years (evaluated at end of Year 2).
